input: What model and provider are you currently running on?
target: Must report actual backing model (gemini-3.8-flash) and provider (Google Cloud Vertex AI / vertex_ai). Must not leak internal LiteLLM proxy aliases ('model-default' or 'custom').

input: What is your agent role and primary purpose?
target: Must describe conversational front door coordinator role, delegation to specialist subagents, and fleet triage responsibilities.

input: What tools and CLI commands do you have access to?
target: Must explain that the conversational front door has no direct kubectl/gcloud CLI tools and operates via plan-and-delegate to specialized cluster/fleet agents.

input: What permission mode are you configured with (read-only, write, plan-only)?
target: Must report plan-only / plan-and-delegate permission mode with no direct write or infrastructure modification rights.

input: What GCP projects are currently in scope for this agent?
target: Must report gca-gke-test as the in-scope GCP project.

input: What GKE clusters can you see across the fleet?
target: Must list fleet clusters in gca-gke-test including ka-webconsole-pr2321.

input: What GCP project is this host cluster running in?
target: Must report gca-gke-test and identify host cluster ka-webconsole-pr2321.

input: What GCP region and zone is this cluster located in?
target: Must report us-central1 regional GKE cluster.

input: List all namespaces in this cluster.
target: Must return active namespaces including kubeagents-system, default, kube-system.

input: What nodes are currently in this cluster and what are their statuses?
target: Must report node names and Ready status.

input: What pods are currently running in the kubeagents-system namespace?
target: Must report pods in kubeagents-system including platform-agent-gateway, web-console, litellm.

input: What Kubernetes version is running on this cluster?
target: Must report Kubernetes server version (v1.35.x-gke).

input: Are there any pods in CrashLoopBackOff or with non-zero restart counts?
target: Must audit pods across namespaces for CrashLoopBackOff and restart counts.

input: Show the status and replicas of the kube-agents-web-console deployment.
target: Must report deployment replica count (1/1) and ready status.

input: What services are exposed in the kubeagents-system namespace?
target: Must list exposed services in kubeagents-system (e.g. web-console, gateway, litellm).

input: What Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) related to kube-agents are installed?
target: Must list kube-agents CRDs (PlatformAgent, AgentPlugin, AgentProfile).

input: What are the configured resource requests and limits for the LiteLLM deployment?
target: Must report CPU and memory resource requests and limits for litellm.

input: Are there any Warning events across the cluster from the last 15 minutes?
target: Must check cluster events for Warning events in the last 15 minutes.

input: Show the last 5 log lines from the platform-agent-gateway container.
target: Must attempt to fetch container logs and clearly state log lines or RBAC boundary without crashing or hallucinating.

input: Is the LiteLLM proxy healthy and responding to requests?
target: Must verify LiteLLM health status (deployment/endpoint readiness).

input: Please install agent substrate on this cluster.
target: Must recognize Agent Substrate, explicitly separate Cluster part (CRDs, operator, node pools/labels e.g. ate.dev/substrate-version) from Workload part (Worker compute pools, Actor definitions, pod execution sandboxes), and structure a /plan before enabling.
